notes.title: Update 1.6.5 Balance and Improvements
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.6.5 Balance and Improvements
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Random D-Module drops replaced for unique per mission. So 11 missions total, always
[*] Weapons quantity Player's ship can carry doubled Up to 22. Starts with 2 and 2 extra for each D-Module collected
[*] All wrecks now marked by icons of weapon they carry. Easy to decide if you want to attach it
[*] The time wrecks alive increased for 3 to 6 seconds
[*] Size of all projectiles incresed
[*] Size of crosshair increased
[*] Speed of all projectiles increased
[*] Reload time for all weapon reduced
[*] Enemy spawn formula changed for more problems enemies around. Their attacks increasing by time in mission and by already collected quantity of D-modules
[*] Sparks, engine fire and flashes reworked for better performance
[*] Added message inside base location explained how to start mission
[/list]

Special thanks for Space Game Junkie https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32549618/ and Indie Gems https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32732116-IndieGems/ for feedback and suggestions o// and for every curators did a step into.

notes.title: Update 1.6.3 Game Balance
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The total number of ships the player can carry increases with each D-Module, starting from 1 with 0 D-Modules up to 11 with 10 D-Modules on the 11th mission.
[*] An info counter has been added to the HUD, showing the current weapon count / max available slots.
[*] All enemy ship HP has been balanced and grows with the player's progress.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.6.1: Weapon Mode
notes.notes:
[h1]Weapon Mode Update Notes:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Standard Machine Gun – Reliable and straightforward. A classic you can always count on.
[*] Silver Rocket Launcher – Fires unguided silver rockets. Simple, yet devastating.
[*] Gold Rocket Launcher – Fires guided golden rockets that track their targets. Precision at its finest.
[*] Cluster Missile – Splits into three deadly warheads mid-flight, spreading destruction across the battlefield.
[*] Penetrating Needles – Sharp projectiles that pierce through multiple enemies in one shot.
[*] Radioactive Sticky Bomb – Latches onto enemies and poisons them over time. A slow but deadly takedown.
[*] Sonic Wave – Pushes everything around you away. Make some space in the heat of battle.
[*] EMP Net Projectile – Disrupts enemy weapon charging systems. Turn the tide in a flash.
[*] Circular Damage Shield – Protect yourself while dealing damage to enemies nearby. Defense with a bite.
[*] Anti-Ship Mines – Deploy these in space to create deadly traps for your foes.
[*] Heat Decoy – A diversionary projectile that attracts incoming missiles and buys you precious seconds.
[/olist]
[b]Collect all 11 unique ships in battle to unlock their full arsenal![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.5.9 - Twin Stick Engaged! Now with rumble!
notes.notes:
With supports from curators and community, 
- Controllers support was fully implemented, included vibrations (rumble)
- Bullets/Rockets triggers separated for both Mouse/Gamepad controls
- Minor changes

notes.title: Update 1.5.8 - FPS - PVE Balance - Background
notes.notes:
Update 1.5.8 makes the game more casual and player friendly:
- Enemy strength and spawn timer growth changed to non-linear
- The game speed balanced and now stable
- Game background colors tuned to not disturb battlefield view

Huge thanks to StormShadow277 for the his feedback
